migrationMissing: Migration 0137 (communities) has not been applied on the server yet.
noAreaKey: No area key — the community settings cannot be saved.

list.unlockWhy: Communities seal names and settings in this browser.
list.title: Communities
list.meta: Groups, classes, circles, choirs, retreat sessions — a tree of units with positions and people with personal links.
list.empty: No community yet. Start with “New community” — five questions, each with a suggestion.
list.mergeNote: E.g. two districts under a diocese. The chosen communities become units of the new one; their areas, roles and links stay.
list.topName: Name of the new top unit
list.jsonSummary: New community from JSON (e.g. prepared by AI)
list.jsonLead: A “recreatio/community” document sets up a whole community at once. The format description and examples (school, Domestic Church, youth group, retreat session, choir, learning group) are below — the AI assistant knows the same description through MCP.

result.newLinks: New links — copy them now (later: the “People” tab)
result.slowKeys: Each new role and link takes a dozen seconds or so of key computation in this browser — don't close the tab.

view.unreadable: The settings of this community cannot be opened.
view.notCommunity: This area is not a community.
view.jsonSummary: Community as JSON — export and import
view.jsonLead: The whole community in one document: units, positions, blueprints, people and the settings of the five steps. Change it (with AI too) and import it — the import shows the list of changes.
view.renewLine: {name}: NEW link, the old one stops working.

people.namesLabel: Full name — one person per line
people.linkAfterSave: the link is created after saving
people.linkNotYours: the link is not yours or was revoked

staffing.none: No position says how many are needed. In “Unit” → step 3 → position → “More”, enter “People needed”, or in JSON "per" (e.g. one animator per 4 participants).

managed.root: Community <link>“{name}”</link> — units, positions, people and settings. Manual changes to roles, pages and chats here may be overwritten by the next save of the community.
managed.unit: Managed by the community <link>“{name}”</link> · unit “{unit}”. Manual changes to roles, pages and chats here may be overwritten by the next save of the community.

mine.noLink: This browser has no personal link. Open the link you got from your leaders.
mine.noUnits: This link does not give access to any unit yet.

structure.moveAskBody: The change goes into the plan — it is saved only after “Save changes”.
structure.dragHint: Drag a unit onto another to move it there.

unit.noChildren: None yet — you can start with one unit, add a second next to it and later put both under a new one.
unit.councilNote: Membership follows the staffing: whoever takes a position is in the council; whoever gives it up leaves.
unit.positionsNote: A position described once works in many units. Rights: {rights}.
unit.notInCommunity: This unit is not in the community.
unit.saveAsBlueprint: Save as a blueprint (for similar units)

examples.dkRejon13: Domestic Church: a district with three circles and a district circle
examples.dkRejon1: Domestic Church: a second district (later both under a diocese)
examples.oaza: parish youth group (groups by stage automatically, schola, theatre)
examples.turnus: retreat session (sign-up with a limit, groups, staffing)
examples.dkKrakow: Domestic Church: archdiocese → regions → circles (reference, no persons)

wizard.meta: Five questions; you can change every answer later in the settings.
wizard.namePlaceholder: e.g. Parish choir, District XIII, Class 2b
wizard.notTypes: These are not types — just ready-made settings to change.

run.needPassword: Enter your password first — the import seals in this browser.
run.noPerson: This account has no person yet who could do this.
run.unreadable: The community settings cannot be opened with this account.
run.isUnit: This area is a unit of the community “{name}” — change it there.
run.noParent: “{name}”: the unit above was not created — skipped.
run.notYourArea: you do not lead this area
run.areaGone: “{name}”: the unit's area no longer exists — creating a new one.
run.noRoot: The unit “{name}” was not created — nothing else was done.
run.stateNotSaved: The community state was not saved ({why}).
run.accessNoRole: Access ({why}): the role is not in your account — skipped.
run.accessNoIssuer: Access ({why}): you cannot let anyone into this area — skipped.
run.accessLine: Access from the tree: added — {joined}, removed — {dropped}, total — {all}.
run.noRoles: {name}: the roles of their places do not exist yet — no link.
run.notAllRoles: {name}: you do not hold all roles of their places (a community leader can give this link) — skipped.
run.oldRevokeFailed: {name}: the old link was not revoked ({why}).
run.viewNotSaved: “{name}”: the unit view was not saved ({why}).

lead.label: Leading
lead.says: changes everything in the unit and in all units below it; lets others in

accompany.label: Accompanying
accompany.says: sees everything in the unit and below it, changes nothing (e.g. a priest moderator)

cooperate.label: Cooperating
cooperate.says: writes in the unit (dates, materials), e.g. an animator with their own group

member.label: Membership
member.says: belongs to the unit, writes in its chats and calendar

participant.label: Participation
participant.says: reads what the unit shares, and talks

steps.s5: What do you use and who sees what?

limited.label: For a time — with a start and an end

onsite.label: On site
onsite.example: meetings in a room, rehearsals, lessons

online.label: Online
online.example: a group that mostly talks and learns online — no places or rooms

asNeeded.label: As needed
asNeeded.example: a group learning at its own pace

yearFrom.label: Working year from (MM-DD)
yearFrom.hint: e.g. 09-01 — past years are kept as an archive

anyone.label: Anyone can join
anyone.example: parish choir, youth group, retreat with sign-ups

byField.label: Automatically, by a trait of the person
byField.example: all tenors, everyone in ONŻ I°

byField.label: By field
byField.hint: key of a field from step 4, e.g. “glos”

council.label: Council of the leaders of the units below
council.hint: e.g. a district circle: the district couple, the moderator and all animator couples — membership follows the staffing

founders.label: Who creates new units under this one

lead.label: Also the leaders of this unit

leaders.label: A leader adds people
leaders.example: class, circle, learning group — everyone gets a personal link

link.label: Invitation by link
link.example: one link for all new choir members

signup.label: Public sign-up through a form
signup.example: retreat session, youth group with enrolment

waitlist.label: Waiting list once places run out

requires.label: Requirements (e.g. a stage in the given year)

confirm.label: A leader confirms admission
confirm.hint: the personal link comes only after admission

askLeaders.label: Everyone can write privately to the leaders

direct.label: People also write to each other, one to one

default.label: Who sees new content by default

subtree.label: This unit with everything below it

subunitsSee.label: Units below see this unit (its dates, materials)
subunitsSee.hint: e.g. all districts and circles see the diocese's dates

compile.placesWaitlist: Number of places: {count}. Once they are taken, we add people to a waiting list.
compile.confirm: The leaders confirm each sign-up — then the personal link arrives.
compile.afterBody: Here the leaders describe how it went.
compile.insideBody: A page for the people of this unit: dates, chat, contact with the leaders.
compile.saysOwnerUnknown: pagesBy “{said}”: no such position here or above — the address stays with whoever imports
compile.saysOwnerLater: pages go to “{said}” of the unit above once its role exists (this save)

plan.claimAddress: The page address “{address}” must be claimed first (Pages → Claim address) — without it the units' pages will not be created; the addresses of the units below sit under it.
plan.needController: Chats and sign-ups are created only once the top area has a data controller (Areas → area → Settings) — after naming one, save the community again.
plan.dissolved: Dissolved: “{name}” — the area and its content stay, the community removes the access it gave.
plan.takenOverUnder: Existing area “{area}” taken over as “{name}” — moved under “{parent}”.
plan.placesChanged: {name}: places changed — NEW link, the old one stops working.
plan.personMissing: {name}: not in the document — stays unchanged (to remove: "remove": true).
plan.unitMissing: “{name}”: not in the document — stays unchanged (to dissolve: "remove": true).
